t: This long, pale, stepped terrace of concrete is the Alexandra Road Estate, a brutalist housing estate in Camden. It was designed in 1968 by Neave Brown of Camden Council's Architects Department. Building ran from 1972 to 1978, in white, board-marked reinforced concrete cast on site. Besides 520 apartments, it has a school, a community centre, a youth club, a heating complex, a tenants hall and parkland. Brown specialised in modernist housing, and he is the only architect to have all his UK work listed. That includes this estate, the Dunboyne Road Estate and the houses in Winscombe Street, all in Camden. The estate also appears in the TV series The Sweeney.
